channel.title: Not Enough Time
channel.description: A curated summary of contemporary frontier discussions.

item.title: AI hits limits on money, chips and security
item.description: Banks are locking AI assistants out of customer accounts. Lenders and factory limits choke off the race to build AI data centers. AI-powered hacking is exposing old software flaws faster than companies can fix them.

item.title: AI computing power becomes a traded commodity
item.description: AI is squeezing traditional software profits and changing how engineers get paid. Crypto money shifts from startups to tradable tokens, and traditional finance pushes back. Traders are turning AI computing hours into a financial commodity like oil.
